name: hud_layout_sw_global_destructor
description: HudLayoutSW::GlobalDestructor destroys the embedded TYPEI widget and then the base container for a software HUD layout object.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; the MSVC EH destructor frame is deferred to the HUD layout source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly/HLIL for 0x40d2a0 shows the MSVC destructor EH frame, HudUiWidget::DestructorCore on this+0x30, then HudUiContainer::DestructorCore on this.

The native smoke invokes HudLayoutSW::GlobalDestructor on a constructed layout and verifies the embedded widget ftable resets to g_HudUiCommon_FTable and the container ftable resets to g_HudUiContainer_FTable.
